briefings.title: The Most Founder Mode CEO Working Today Isn’t the Founder: Opendoor’s Kaz Nejatian
briefings.tldr: Kaz Nejatian discusses his "refounding" of Opendoor, arguing that enduring companies are built on the "first derivatives" of their core business and that true "Founder Mode" requires a radical prioritization of outcomes over processes and a total rejection of life’s defaults.

briefings.title: Inside Opendoor: The $2.8B Bet with CEO Kaz Nejatian
briefings.tldr: CEO Kaz Nejatian is executing a radical, product-driven turnaround at Opendoor by stripping away corporate bureaucracy, replacing human-intensive processes with AI, and reintroducing "founder energy" to a public company that was previously in a "slow decline" under professional management.
